test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Marks scored by Reena are plotted on the graph. Calculate how much more marks she scored in science, than hindi? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e5ef6c65ff1066b34f37f56a94acdecda69baf6dfddff4ade0edfbdb5e14927.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Marks in Science = 37

Marks in Hindi = 35

Difference in score in Science and Hindi = 37 - 35 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**
